from typing import Optional
import pandas as pd

def extract_series_uid(mask_path: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    mask_path example:
    'Mass-Training_P_00001_LEFT_CC_1/.../SeriesUID/000001.dcm'
    We want the second last part = SeriesUID.
    """
    if pd.isna(mask_path):
        return None
    
    # normalise and split
    parts = str(mask_path).replace("\\", "/").strip().split("/")
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return None
    return parts[-2]


def prepare_split(df, lesion_type: str, split: str):
    df = df.copy()
    df["lesion_type"] = lesion_type
    df["split"] = split

    # rename columns to standard names if they exist
    rename_map = {
        "image file path": "image_rel",
        "cropped image file path": "crop_rel",
        "ROI mask file path": "mask_rel",
        "pathology": "pathology"
    }
    # only rename columns that actually exist to avoid KeyError
    rename_map = {k: v for k, v in rename_map.items() if k in df.columns}
    df.rename(columns=rename_map, inplace=True)

    # create series_uid from mask_rel (if present)
    if "mask_rel" in df.columns:
        df["series_uid"] = df["mask_rel"].apply(extract_series_uid)
    else:
        df["series_uid"] = None

    return df


# build combined meta table
mass_train_p = prepare_split(mass_train, "mass", "train")
mass_test_p  = prepare_split(mass_test,  "mass", "test")
calc_train_p = prepare_split(calc_train, "calc", "train")
calc_test_p  = prepare_split(calc_test,  "calc", "test")

meta = pd.concat(
    [mass_train_p, mass_test_p, calc_train_p, calc_test_p],
    ignore_index=True
)

print("Meta rows before join:", meta.shape)

# Map pathology → binary label
label_map = {
    "BENIGN": 0,
    "BENIGN_WITHOUT_CALLBACK": 0,
    "MALIGNANT": 1
}
meta["label"] = meta["pathology"].map(label_map)

print(meta["label"].value_counts(dropna=False))
meta.head()

from typing import Optional
import os
import pandas as pd

# 1. Reduce dicom_info to what we need, but avoid name clash by renaming column
dicom_small = dicom_info[["SeriesInstanceUID", "image_path"]].copy()
dicom_small = dicom_small.rename(columns={"image_path": "dicom_image_path"})

# 2. Join: many JPEG patches per series_uid → more rows
meta = meta.merge(
    dicom_small,
    left_on="series_uid",
    right_on="SeriesInstanceUID",
    how="left"
)

print("After join:", meta.shape)
print("N rows with missing dicom_image_path:", meta["dicom_image_path"].isna().sum())


# 3. Convert CBIS dicom_image_path to local absolute JPEG path
def dicom_jpeg_to_local(p: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if pd.isna(p):
        return None

    p = str(p).strip()
    # remove 'CBIS-DDSM/jpeg/' prefix if present
    if "CBIS-DDSM/jpeg/" in p:
        rel = p.split("CBIS-DDSM/jpeg/")[-1]
    else:
        rel = p

    rel = rel.replace("/", os.sep)
    full = JPEG_DIR / rel
    return str(full)


meta["image_path"] = meta["dicom_image_path"].apply(dicom_jpeg_to_local)

# 4. Keep only rows whose JPEG exists
meta = meta[meta["image_path"].apply(lambda x: x is not None and os.path.exists(x))]
meta = meta.reset_index(drop=True)

print("Final meta:", meta.shape)
display(meta[["patient_id", "lesion_type", "split", "pathology", "image_path"]].head())

def show_random_samples(df, n=6):
    sample = df.sample(n)
    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
    for i, (_, row) in enumerate(sample.iterrows()):
        img = Image.open(row["image_path"]).convert("L")
        plt.subplot(2, (n+1)//2, i+1)
        plt.imshow(img, cmap="gray")
        plt.axis("off")
        plt.title(f"{row['lesion_type']}, {row['pathology']}")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

def jpeg_to_png(jpeg_path: str) -> str:
    jpeg_path = Path(jpeg_path)
    png_path = PNG_DIR / (jpeg_path.stem + ".png")
    if not png_path.exists():
        img = Image.open(jpeg_path).convert("L")
        img.save(png_path)
    return str(png_path)

meta["image_png"] = meta["image_path"].apply(jpeg_to_png)

import numpy as np

train_df_full = meta[meta["split"] == "train"].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = meta[meta["split"] == "test"].reset_index(drop=True)

print("Train lesions:", train_df_full.shape)
print("Test  lesions:", test_df.shape)

# ============================================================================
# FIX: Split at PATIENT LEVEL (not image level)
# ============================================================================

# Step 1: Get unique patients
unique_patients = train_df_full['patient_id'].unique()
print(f"\nUnique patients in training: {len(unique_patients)}")

# Step 2: Create patient-level labels (max label per patient)
patient_labels = train_df_full.groupby('patient_id')['label'].max()
patient_labels_array = np.array([patient_labels[p] for p in unique_patients])

# Step 3: Stratified split of PATIENTS (not images)
sss = StratifiedShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
patient_train_idx, patient_val_idx = next(
    sss.split(unique_patients, patient_labels_array)
)

# Step 4: Get patient sets
train_patients_set = set(unique_patients[patient_train_idx])
val_patients_set = set(unique_patients[patient_val_idx])

print(f"Patients in training: {len(train_patients_set)}")
print(f"Patients in validation: {len(val_patients_set)}")

# Step 5: Filter dataframes by patient assignment
train_df2 = train_df_full[
    train_df_full['patient_id'].isin(train_patients_set)
].reset_index(drop=True)

val_df = train_df_full[
    train_df_full['patient_id'].isin(val_patients_set)
].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"\nTrain: {train_df2.shape[0]} images from {len(train_patients_set)} patients")
print(f"Val:   {val_df.shape[0]} images from {len(val_patients_set)} patients")

# VERIFICATION: Check for patient overlap
overlap = train_patients_set & val_patients_set
if overlap:
    print(f"⚠️  WARNING: {len(overlap)} patients overlap!")
else:
    print("✓ No patient overlap - split is correct!")

# Check overlap with test set
test_patients = set(test_df['patient_id'].unique())
train_test_overlap = train_patients_set & test_patients
val_test_overlap = val_patients_set & test_patients

if train_test_overlap:
    print(f"⚠️  WARNING: {len(train_test_overlap)} patients overlap between train and test")
else:
    print("✓ No train-test patient overlap")

if val_test_overlap:
    print(f"⚠️  WARNING: {len(val_test_overlap)} patients overlap between val and test")
else:
    print("✓ No val-test patient overlap")

# FIXED: Separate transforms for training (with augmentation) vs val/test
# ============================================================================

train_transforms = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
    transforms.RandomRotation(degrees=10),
    transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.1, contrast=0.1),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize(
        mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],
        std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    )
])

val_test_transforms = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize(
        mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406],
        std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
    )
])

print("✓ Train transforms: with augmentation (flip, rotation, color jitter)")
print("✓ Val/Test transforms: without augmentation")

# Load CLIP
clip_model, _, clip_preprocess = open_clip.create_model_and_transforms(
    "ViT-B-32",
    pretrained="laion2b_s34b_b79k",
    device=device
)
clip_model.eval()

# ============================================================================
# FIXED: Dataset class with support for different transforms
# ============================================================================

class CBISDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None, use_png=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.transform = transform
        self.use_png = use_png

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        path = row["image_png"] if self.use_png else row["image_path"]
        img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")

        # Use provided transform (different for train vs val/test)
        if self.transform:
            img_imnet = self.transform(img)
        else:
            img_imnet = val_test_transforms(img)

        img_clip = clip_preprocess(img)

        label = int(row["label"])
        return img_imnet, img_clip, label

print("✓ Dataset class updated to support different transforms")

# ============================================================================
# FIXED: Create datasets with different transforms
# ============================================================================

batch_size = 16

# Pass different transforms to each dataset
train_ds = CBISDataset(train_df2, transform=train_transforms, use_png=False)
val_ds   = CBISDataset(val_df,   transform=val_test_transforms, use_png=False)
test_ds  = CBISDataset(test_df,  transform=val_test_transforms, use_png=False)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True,  num_workers=0)
val_loader   = DataLoader(val_ds,   batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)
test_loader  = DataLoader(test_ds,  batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

print(f"✓ Train loader: {len(train_loader)} batches (with augmentation)")
print(f"✓ Val loader:   {len(val_loader)} batches (no augmentation)")
print(f"✓ Test loader:  {len(test_loader)} batches (no augmentation)")

import numpy as np
import torch

device = torch.device("cpu")  # you said CPU only

# make sure models are on the right device and in eval mode
resnet.to(device)
vit.to(device)
clip_model.to(device)

resnet.eval()
vit.eval()
clip_model.eval()


def extract_features(dataloader, max_batches=None, use_clip=False):
    """
    Extract hybrid features:
    - ResNet + ViT always
    - Optional CLIP (VLM) to save time when needed

    max_batches: limit for speed; None = all batches in the loader
    """
    all_feats = []
    all_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for b, (imgs_imnet, imgs_clip, labels) in enumerate(dataloader):
            imgs_imnet = imgs_imnet.to(device)
            imgs_clip  = imgs_clip.to(device)

            # CNN features
            f_res = resnet(imgs_imnet)   # [B, D_res]
            # ViT features
            f_vit = vit(imgs_imnet)     # [B, D_vit]

            if use_clip:
                # CLIP (VLM) visual tower
                f_clip = clip_model.encode_image(imgs_clip)  # [B, D_clip]
                # concat ResNet + ViT + CLIP
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit, f_clip], dim=1)
            else:
                # concat only ResNet + ViT (much faster)
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit], dim=1)

            all_feats.append(feats.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.numpy())

            if max_batches is not None and (b + 1) >= max_batches:

    X = np.concatenate(all_feats, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)

import numpy as np
import torch

device = torch.device("cpu")   # you’re on CPU

# make sure models are on the correct device and in eval mode
resnet.to(device)
vit.to(device)
clip_model.to(device)

resnet.eval()
vit.eval()
clip_model.eval()


def extract_features(dataloader, max_batches=None, use_clip=False):
    """
    Hybrid feature extraction:
      - always uses ResNet + ViT
      - CLIP (VLM) is optional because it is very slow on CPU
      - max_batches lets you limit work for speed
    """
    all_feats = []
    all_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for b, (imgs_imnet, imgs_clip, labels) in enumerate(dataloader):
            imgs_imnet = imgs_imnet.to(device)
            imgs_clip  = imgs_clip.to(device)

            # CNN features
            f_res = resnet(imgs_imnet)
            # ViT features
            f_vit = vit(imgs_imnet)

            if use_clip:
                # CLIP (VLM) visual tower – VERY SLOW on CPU
                f_clip = clip_model.encode_image(imgs_clip)
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit, f_clip], dim=1)
            else:
                # only ResNet + ViT (much faster)
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit], dim=1)

            all_feats.append(feats.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.numpy())

            if max_batches is not None and (b + 1) >= max_batches:
                break

    X = np.concatenate(all_feats, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    return X, y

from typing import Optional
from tqdm import tqdm  # optional, for progress bar

def extract_features(dataloader, max_batches: Optional[int] = None, use_clip: bool = False):
    """
    Extract hybrid deep features from dataloader.

    - ResNet + ViT are always used.
    - CLIP visual features are optional (use_clip=True).
    - max_batches limits how many batches to process (None = all).
    """
    all_feats = []
    all_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for b, (imgs_imnet, imgs_clip, labels) in enumerate(tqdm(dataloader, desc="Extracting", leave=False)):
            imgs_imnet = imgs_imnet.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            imgs_clip  = imgs_clip.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            # CNN features
            f_res = resnet(imgs_imnet)      # [B, D_res]
            # ViT features
            f_vit = vit(imgs_imnet)        # [B, D_vit]

            if use_clip:
                # CLIP (VLM) visual tower
                f_clip = clip_model.encode_image(imgs_clip)  # [B, D_clip]
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit, f_clip], dim=1)
            else:
                # Only ResNet + ViT (faster)
                feats = torch.cat([f_res, f_vit], dim=1)

            all_feats.append(feats.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.numpy())

            if max_batches is not None and (b + 1) >= max_batches:
                break

    X = np.concatenate(all_feats, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(all_labels, axis=0)
    return X, y

def eval_split(name, y_true, y_prob):
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===")
    print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred))
    print("Precision:", precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("F1       :", f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("ROC AUC  :", roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob))

y_val_prob  = rf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_test_prob = rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

eval_split("Validation", y_val,  y_val_prob)
eval_split("Test",       y_test, y_test_prob)

y_val_pred  = (y_val_prob  >= 0.5).astype(int)
y_test_pred = (y_test_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)

labels = ["Benign (0)", "Malignant (1)"]

def plot_confusion_matrix(cm, title):
    plt.figure(figsize=(4, 4))
    plt.imshow(cm, interpolation="nearest")
    plt.title(title)
    plt.colorbar()
    plt.xticks([0, 1], labels, rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.yticks([0, 1], labels)
    plt.xlabel("Predicted label")
    plt.ylabel("True label")

    # write numbers inside cells
    max_val = cm.max()
    for i in range(cm.shape[0]):
        for j in range(cm.shape[1]):
            val = cm[i, j]
            color = "white" if val > max_val / 2 else "black"
            plt.text(j, i, val, ha="center", va="center", color=color)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

plot_confusion_matrix(cm_val,  "Confusion Matrix – Validation")
plot_confusion_matrix(cm_test, "Confusion Matrix – Test")

X_val_full,   y_val_full   = extract_features(val_loader,   max_batches=None, use_clip=False)
X_test_full,  y_test_full  = extract_features(test_loader,  max_batches=None, use_clip=False)

print("Full (CNN+ViT) shapes:")
print("Train:", X_train_full.shape)
print("Val  :", X_val_full.shape)
print("Test :", X_test_full.shape)

# --------- Train RF on full CNN+ViT features ----------
rf_base = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42
)
rf_base.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# --------- Evaluate ---------
def eval_split(name, y_true, y_prob):
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===")
    print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred))
    print("Precision:", precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("F1       :", f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0))
    print("ROC AUC  :", roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob))
    return {
        "acc":  accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred),
        "prec": precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        "rec":  recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        "f1":   f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        "auc":  roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob),
    }

y_val_full_prob  = rf_base.predict_proba(X_val_full)[:, 1]
y_test_full_prob = rf_base.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]

metrics_full_val  = eval_split("Validation – CNN+ViT (full)", y_val_full,  y_val_full_prob)
metrics_full_test = eval_split("Test – CNN+ViT (full)",       y_test_full, y_test_full_prob)

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    roc_auc_score
)

def simple_metrics(name, y_true, y_prob):
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)

    acc  = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
    prec = precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    rec  = recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    f1   = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    auc  = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob)

    print(f"\n====== {name} ======")
    print("Accuracy :", round(acc, 4))
    print("Precision:", round(prec, 4))
    print("Recall   :", round(rec, 4))
    print("F1 Score :", round(f1, 4))
    print("ROC AUC  :", round(auc, 4))

# Run evaluation
y_val_prob  = rf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_test_prob = rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

simple_metrics("Validation", y_val,  y_val_prob)
simple_metrics("Test",       y_test, y_test_prob)

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score

# 1. Scale features (important for ViT/CLIP/CNN mixing)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_s = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_s   = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_s  = scaler.transform(X_test)

# 2. Reduce dimensionality but keep hybrid information
#    Try 64, 128, 256, 512 and see which gives best val AUC.
pca = PCA(n_components=256, random_state=42)
X_train_p = pca.fit_transform(X_train_s)
X_val_p   = pca.transform(X_val_s)
X_test_p  = pca.transform(X_test_s)

print("Train PCA shape:", X_train_p.shape)
print("Val   PCA shape:", X_val_p.shape)
print("Test  PCA shape:", X_test_p.shape)

# 3. RandomForest on compressed hybrid features
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=None,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42
)
rf.fit(X_train_p, y_train)

# 4. Simple evaluation
def simple_metrics(name, y_true, y_prob):
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)
    acc  = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
    prec = precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    rec  = recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    f1   = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    auc  = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob)
    print(f"\n====== {name} ======")
    print("Accuracy :", round(acc, 4))
    print("Precision:", round(prec, 4))
    print("Recall   :", round(rec, 4))
    print("F1 Score :", round(f1, 4))
    print("ROC AUC  :", round(auc, 4))

y_val_prob  = rf.predict_proba(X_val_p)[:, 1]
y_test_prob = rf.predict_proba(X_test_p)[:, 1]

simple_metrics("Validation – hybrid RF+PCA", y_val,  y_val_prob)
simple_metrics("Test – hybrid RF+PCA",       y_test, y_test_prob)

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, roc_auc_score
)

# X_train, X_val, X_test = your hybrid features (CNN+ViT+CLIP)
# y_train, y_val, y_test = labels (0/1)

hybrid_rf = Pipeline([
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("pca",    PCA(n_components=256, random_state=42)),  # try 128 / 256 / 512
    ("rf",     RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=None,              # you can also try 20–40
        class_weight="balanced",
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )),
])

hybrid_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict probabilities
y_val_prob  = hybrid_rf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
y_test_prob = hybrid_rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

def simple_metrics(name, y_true, y_prob):
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)
    acc  = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
    prec = precision_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    rec  = recall_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    f1   = f1_score(y_true, y_pred, zero_division=0)
    auc  = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob)
    print(f"\n====== {name} ======")
    print("Accuracy :", round(acc, 4))
    print("Precision:", round(prec, 4))
    print("Recall   :", round(rec, 4))
    print("F1 Score :", round(f1, 4))
    print("ROC AUC  :", round(auc, 4))

simple_metrics("Validation – hybrid RF", y_val,  y_val_prob)
simple_metrics("Test – hybrid RF",       y_test, y_test_prob)

import numpy as np

thresholds = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 17)
best_t, best_f1 = 0.5, -1

for t in thresholds:
    y_val_pred = (y_val_prob >= t).astype(int)
    f1 = f1_score(y_val, y_val_pred, zero_division=0)
    if f1 > best_f1:
        best_f1, best_t = f1, t

print("Best threshold on validation:", best_t, "F1:", round(best_f1, 4))

# Apply this threshold to test
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score

y_test_pred = (y_test_prob >= best_t).astype(int)
print("\nTest with tuned threshold:")
print("Accuracy :", round(accuracy_score(y_test, y_test_pred), 4))
print("Precision:", round(precision_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("Recall   :", round(recall_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("F1 Score :", round(f1_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("ROC AUC  :", round(roc_auc_score(y_test, y_test_prob), 4))

from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, roc_auc_score

# 1) Fit pipeline on all train+val
pipe.fit(X_all, y_all)

# 2) Predict on test set
y_test_prob = pipe.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_test_pred = (y_test_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)

# 3) Metrics on held-out test set
print("===== Final Test Performance (pipeline) =====")
print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_test, y_test_pred))
print("F1 Score :", f1_score(y_test, y_test_pred))
print("ROC AUC  :", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_test_prob))
print("\nClassification report:\n")
print(classification_report(y_test, y_test_pred))

from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score

thresholds = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 17)
best_t, best_f1 = 0.5, -1

for t in thresholds:
    y_val_pred = (y_val_prob >= t).astype(int)
    f1 = f1_score(y_val, y_val_pred, zero_division=0)
    if f1 > best_f1:
        best_f1, best_t = f1, t

print("Best threshold on validation:", round(best_t, 3), "F1:", round(best_f1, 4))

# apply to test
y_test_pred = (y_test_prob >= best_t).astype(int)
print("\nTest with tuned threshold:")
print("Accuracy :", round(accuracy_score(y_test, y_test_pred), 4))
print("Precision:", round(precision_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("Recall   :", round(recall_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("F1 Score :", round(f1_score(y_test, y_test_pred, zero_division=0), 4))
print("ROC AUC  :", round(roc_auc_score(y_test, y_test_prob), 4))

# CELL 5 — Convert DICOM path → UID → JPEG path

import re

# Extract the UID from the 2nd folder level of "image file path"
# Example: "Calc-Training_P_00005_RIGHT_CC/<UID1>/<UID2>/000000.dcm"

def extract_uid(path):
    try:
        parts = path.split("/")
        # UID is usually the second-level folder, but sometimes DDSM format varies.
        # We'll grab the second UID (index 2)
        for p in parts:
            if p.count(".") > 3:   # heuristic: UIDs have many dots
                return p
        return None
    except:
        return None

meta["uid"] = meta["image file path"].apply(extract_uid)

print("Sample extracted UIDs:")
print(meta["uid"].head(10))

# Merge meta with dicom_info on uid
dicom_info["uid"] = dicom_info["image_path"].apply(lambda x: x.split("/")[-2])

merged = pd.merge(meta, dicom_info[["uid", "image_path"]], on="uid", how="left")

print("\nMerged shape:", merged.shape)
print("Missing JPEG paths:", merged["image_path"].isna().sum())

# Convert image_path to full path
merged["image_path"] = merged["image_path"].apply(
    lambda x: os.path.join(str(CBIS_DIR), x) if isinstance(x, str) else None
)

print("\nPreview of merged with real JPEG paths:")
display(merged[["patient_id", "lesion_type", "pathology", "image_path"]].head(10))

# Save clean meta
meta = merged.copy()

# CELL 6 — rebuild meta and merge with dicom_info using relative DICOM paths

import os

# 1) Rebuild combined meta from calc/mass (clean fresh)
calc_train["lesion_type"] = "calc"
calc_test["lesion_type"]  = "calc"
mass_train["lesion_type"] = "mass"
mass_test["lesion_type"]  = "mass"

calc_train["set"] = "train"
calc_test["set"]  = "test"
mass_train["set"] = "train"
mass_test["set"]  = "test"

meta2 = pd.concat([calc_train, calc_test, mass_train, mass_test], axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)

print("meta2 shape:", meta2.shape)
print("meta2 columns:", list(meta2.columns))

# 2) Create a relative DICOM path in dicom_info that should match 'image file path'
print("\nSample dicom_info file_path values:")

# Remove the common prefix "CBIS-DDSM/dicom/" if present
dicom_info["rel_dicom"] = dicom_info["file_path"].str.replace("CBIS-DDSM/dicom/", "", regex=False)

print("\nSample rel_dicom values:")

# 3) Merge meta2["image file path"] with dicom_info["rel_dicom"]
merged2 = pd.merge(
    meta2,
    dicom_info[["rel_dicom", "image_path"]],
    left_on="image file path",
    right_on="rel_dicom",
    how="left"
)

print("Missing JPEG paths:", merged2["image_path"].isna().sum())

# 4) Convert image_path to FULL filesystem path
merged2["image_path"] = merged2["image_path"].apply(

)

# 5) Use this as our main meta
meta = merged2.copy()

# CELL 7a — reset meta from meta2 and extract series_uid from ROI mask file path

meta = meta2.copy().reset_index(drop=True)

def extract_series_uid(mask_path):
    """
    mask_path example:
    'Mass-Training_P_00001_LEFT_CC_1/.../SeriesUID/000001.dcm'
    We want the second last part = SeriesUID.
    """
    if pd.isna(mask_path):
        return None
    parts = str(mask_path).replace("\\", "/").strip().split("/")
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return None
    return parts[-2]   # second last part: .../<SeriesUID>/<image>.dcm

meta["series_uid"] = meta["ROI mask file path"].apply(extract_series_uid)

print("meta shape:", meta.shape)
print("series_uid non-null:", meta["series_uid"].notna().sum())

print("\nSample ROI mask paths + series_uid:")
print(meta[["ROI mask file path", "series_uid"]].head(10))

# CELL 8a — keep valid JPEG rows, remove duplicates, create binary label

meta = meta.copy()

print("Before filtering:", meta.shape)

# 1) Keep only rows that have a JPEG path
meta = meta[meta["image_path"].notna()].copy()
print("After dropping missing image_path:", meta.shape)

# 2) Deduplicate based on patient + lesion + ROI mask + series_uid
meta = meta.drop_duplicates(
    subset=["patient_id", "lesion_type", "ROI mask file path", "series_uid"]
)
print("After dropping duplicate ROI masks:", meta.shape)

# 3) Check pathology distribution
print("\nPathology value counts:")
print(meta["pathology"].value_counts(dropna=False))

# 4) Create binary label: MALIGNANT -> 1, others -> 0 (BENIGN + BENIGN_WITHOUT_CALLBACK)
def make_label(p):
    p = str(p).upper()
    if p.startswith("MALIGNANT"):
        return 1
    else:
        return 0

meta["label"] = meta["pathology"].apply(make_label)

print("\nLabel value counts (0=benign, 1=malignant):")
print(meta["label"].value_counts())

print("\nPreview:")
display(meta[["patient_id", "lesion_type", "pathology", "label", "image_path"]].head(10))

# CELL 9 — patient-wise train/val/test split (NO DATA LEAKAGE)

from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit
import numpy as np

meta_split = meta.copy()

print("Unique patients:", meta_split["patient_id"].nunique())

patients = meta_split["patient_id"].unique()

# -------------------------------
# 70% train, 15% val, 15% test
# -------------------------------
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.30, random_state=42)
train_idx, temp_idx = next(gss.split(patients, groups=patients))

train_patients = patients[train_idx]
temp_patients  = patients[temp_idx]

# split temp into val + test (half/half)
gss2 = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.50, random_state=99)
val_idx, test_idx = next(gss2.split(temp_patients, groups=temp_patients))

val_patients  = temp_patients[val_idx]
test_patients = temp_patients[test_idx]

# -------------------------------
# Assign split to each image row
# -------------------------------
def get_split(pid):
    if pid in train_patients:
        return "train"
    elif pid in val_patients:
        return "val"
    else:
        return "test"

meta_split["split"] = meta_split["patient_id"].apply(get_split)

print("\nCounts per split:")
print(meta_split["split"].value_counts())

# -------------------------------
# HARD CHECK FOR DATA LEAKAGE
# -------------------------------
train_set = set(meta_split[meta_split["split"]=="train"]["patient_id"])
val_set   = set(meta_split[meta_split["split"]=="val"]["patient_id"])
test_set  = set(meta_split[meta_split["split"]=="test"]["patient_id"])

print("\nOverlap (should all be 0):")
print("Train ∩ Val =", len(train_set & val_set))
print("Train ∩ Test =", len(train_set & test_set))
print("Val ∩ Test =", len(val_set & test_set))

# Attach clean meta
meta = meta_split.copy()

print("\nPreview:")
display(meta[["patient_id", "pathology", "label", "split", "image_path"]].head(10))

# CELL 11 — FIX JPEG PATHS

def fix_jpeg_path(p):
    if not isinstance(p, str):
        return None

    # remove wrong prefix
    p = p.replace("CBIS-DDSM/", "")  # keep only the 'jpeg/...'
    
    # build correct full path
    fixed = os.path.join(CBIS_DIR, p)
    fixed = fixed.replace("\\", "/")  # normalize slashes
    return fixed

# CELL A1 — Dataset and DataLoader for CBIS-DDSM (clean, leakage-free)

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from PIL import Image
import torch
import numpy as np

class CbisDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]

        img = Image.open(row["image_path"]).convert("L")   # grayscale
        img = img.resize((224, 224))                     # standard size

        img = np.array(img) / 255.0
        img = np.repeat(img[None, :, :], 3, axis=0)       # (1,H,W) -> (3,H,W)

        img = torch.tensor(img, dtype=torch.float32)

        label = torch.tensor(row["label"], dtype=torch.long)
        pid   = row["patient_id"]

        return {"image": img, "label": label, "pid": pid}

# Create datasets
train_ds = CbisDataset(train_df)
val_ds   = CbisDataset(val_df)
test_ds  = CbisDataset(test_df)

# DataLoaders
train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=16, shuffle=True)
val_loader   = DataLoader(val_ds,   batch_size=16, shuffle=False)
test_loader  = DataLoader(test_ds,  batch_size=16, shuffle=False)

print("DataLoaders ready.")
print("Train batches:", len(train_loader))
print("Val batches:", len(val_loader))
print("Test batches:", len(test_loader))

# CELL A3 — function to compute hybrid embedding per batch

import torch.nn.functional as F

@torch.no_grad()
def get_hybrid_embeddings(batch):
    imgs = batch["image"].to(device)  # (B,3,224,224)

    # -------------------------
    # 1. CNN features (ResNet50)
    # -------------------------
    f_cnn = cnn(imgs)  # (B, 2048)

    # -------------------------
    # 2. ViT features (vit_base_patch16_224)
    # -------------------------
    f_vit = vit(imgs)  # (B, 768)

    # -------------------------
    # 3. CLIP features (ViT-B/32)
    # -------------------------
    f_clip = clip_model.encode_image(imgs)  # (B, 512)
    f_clip = F.normalize(f_clip, dim=-1)    # normalize

    # -------------------------
    # Concatenate embeddings
    # -------------------------
    hybrid = torch.cat([f_cnn, f_vit, f_clip], dim=1)  # (B, 3328)

    return hybrid.cpu().numpy(), batch["label"].numpy(), batch["pid"]

# CELL A4 — extract hybrid embeddings for train/val/test

def extract_all(loader):
    X_list = []
    y_list = []
    pid_list = []

    for i, batch in enumerate(loader):
        Xb, yb, pidb = get_hybrid_embeddings(batch)
        X_list.append(Xb)
        y_list.append(yb)
        pid_list.extend(pidb)

        if i % 20 == 0:
            print(f"Processed batch {i}/{len(loader)}")

    X = np.concatenate(X_list, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(y_list, axis=0)
    return X, y, pid_list

print("Extracting TRAIN embeddings...")
X_train, y_train, pid_train = extract_all(train_loader)
print("Train shape:", X_train.shape)

print("\nExtracting VAL embeddings...")
X_val, y_val, pid_val = extract_all(val_loader)
print("Val shape:", X_val.shape)

print("\nExtracting TEST embeddings...")
X_test, y_test, pid_test = extract_all(test_loader)
print("Test shape:", X_test.shape)

print("\nAll embeddings extracted successfully.")

# CELL A5 — Train Random Forest and evaluate on val + test

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, roc_auc_score
)

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_split=2,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1
)

rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

def eval_split(name, X, y):
    y_prob = rf.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
    y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)

    acc  = accuracy_score(y, y_pred)
    prec = precision_score(y, y_pred)
    rec  = recall_score(y, y_pred)
    f1   = f1_score(y, y_pred)
    auc  = roc_auc_score(y, y_prob)

    print(f"\n=== {name} ===")
    print(f"Accuracy : {acc:.3f}")
    print(f"Precision: {prec:.3f}")
    print(f"Recall   : {rec:.3f}")
    print(f"F1-score : {f1:.3f}")
    print(f"AUC      : {auc:.3f}")

    return {
        "split": name,
        "accuracy": acc,
        "precision": prec,
        "recall": rec,
        "f1": f1,
        "auc": auc,
        "y_true": y,
        "y_pred": y_pred,
        "y_prob": y_prob,
    }

val_results  = eval_split("Validation", X_val,  y_val)
test_results = eval_split("Test",       X_test, y_test)

# FIXED SHAP CELL for RF on hybrid embeddings

import shap
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1) Rebuild explainer (if not already done)
explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(rf)

# 2) Get raw shap values
shap_values_raw = explainer.shap_values(X_test)

print("Type of shap_values_raw:", type(shap_values_raw))

# 3) Handle binary-class RF: shap can return a list [class0, class1] or a single array
if isinstance(shap_values_raw, list):
    print("shap_values_raw is a list of length:", len(shap_values_raw))
    # use the positive class (malignant)
    sv = shap_values_raw[1] if len(shap_values_raw) > 1 else shap_values_raw[0]
else:
    sv = shap_values_raw

print("Raw SHAP array shape:", sv.shape)
print("X_test shape:", X_test.shape)

# 4) If SHAP added an extra column (offset term), drop it
if sv.shape[1] == X_test.shape[1] + 1:
    print("Dropping last SHAP column to match feature dimension...")
    sv = sv[:, :-1]

print("Final SHAP array shape used:", sv.shape)

# 5) Summary bar plot
shap.summary_plot(sv, X_test, show=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("rf_shap_summary.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()

# 6) Beeswarm (dot) plot
shap.summary_plot(sv, X_test, plot_type="dot", show=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("rf_shap_beeswarm.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()

print("Saved rf_shap_summary.png and rf_shap_beeswarm.png")

import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np

@torch.no_grad()
def get_hybrid_embeddings(batch):
    imgs = batch["image"].to(device)  # (B, 3, 224, 224)

    # CNN features (e.g. 2048-d)
    f_cnn = cnn(imgs)

    # ViT features (e.g. 768-d)
    f_vit = vit(imgs)

    # CLIP features (e.g. 512-d)
    f_clip = clip_model.encode_image(imgs)
    f_clip = F.normalize(f_clip, dim=-1)

    # Concatenate: [CNN | ViT | CLIP] → hybrid feature
    hybrid = torch.cat([f_cnn, f_vit, f_clip], dim=1)   # shape: (B, 2048+768+512)

    return hybrid.cpu().numpy(), batch["label"].numpy(), batch["pid"]

# CELL 0 — common imports, device, and helpers

import torch
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix, roc_curve
)

device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
print("Using device:", device)

# helper to extract features from any backbone function
def extract_backbone_feats(loader, feature_fn):
    X_list, y_list = [], []
    for i, batch in enumerate(loader):
        Xb, yb = feature_fn(batch)
        X_list.append(Xb)
        y_list.append(yb)
        if i % 20 == 0:
            print(f"Processed batch {i}/{len(loader)}")
    X = np.concatenate(X_list, axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate(y_list, axis=0)
    return X, y

# helper to print metrics and plot/save confusion matrix + ROC
def eval_and_plot(name, X_val, y_val, X_test, y_test, model, file_prefix):
    # probabilities and preds
    y_prob_val  = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    y_pred_val  = (y_prob_val >= 0.5).astype(int)

    y_prob_test = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    y_pred_test = (y_prob_test >= 0.5).astype(int)

    # metrics (print val + test)
    print(f"\n===== {name} — VALIDATION =====")
    print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_val,  y_pred_val))
    print("Precision:", precision_score(y_val, y_pred_val))
    print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_val,  y_pred_val))
    print("F1-score :", f1_score(y_val,     y_pred_val))
    print("AUC      :", roc_auc_score(y_val, y_prob_val))

    print(f"\n===== {name} — TEST =====")
    print("Accuracy :", accuracy_score(y_test,  y_pred_test))
    print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test, y_pred_test))
    print("Recall   :", recall_score(y_test,  y_pred_test))
    print("F1-score :", f1_score(y_test,     y_pred_test))
    print("AUC      :", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob_test))

    # ---- Confusion matrix (TEST) ----
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_test)
    labels = ["Benign", "Malignant"]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5,4))
    im = ax.imshow(cm, cmap="Blues")
    plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax)

    for (i, j), v in np.ndenumerate(cm):
        ax.text(j, i, int(v), ha="center", va="center")

    ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(labels)
    ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(labels)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted"); ax.set_ylabel("True")
    ax.set_title(f"{name} — Confusion Matrix (Test)")

    plt.tight_layout()
    cm_path = f"{file_prefix}_cm_test.png"
    plt.savefig(cm_path, dpi=300)
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", cm_path)

    # ---- ROC (VAL + TEST) ----
    fpr_val,  tpr_val,  _ = roc_curve(y_val,  y_prob_val)
    fpr_test, tpr_test, _ = roc_curve(y_test, y_prob_test)

    auc_val  = roc_auc_score(y_val,  y_prob_val)
    auc_test = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob_test)

    plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
    plt.plot(fpr_val,  tpr_val,  label=f"Val (AUC={auc_val:.3f})")
    plt.plot(fpr_test, tpr_test, label=f"Test (AUC={auc_test:.3f})")
    plt.plot([0,1], [0,1], "k--", label="Random")

    plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
    plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
    plt.title(f"{name} — ROC Curves")
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    roc_path = f"{file_prefix}_roc_val_test.png"
    plt.savefig(roc_path, dpi=300)
    plt.show()
    print("Saved:", roc_path)
